description: Agent-based educational science (AES) is a research agenda in which educational theories are formalized as interacting agents and environments, enabling in silico experimentation on developmental processes.
title: Agent-based educational science (AES)

description: The article introduces \"a novel simulation methodology\" that models teacher workforce dynamics to attribute teacher quality gaps to their underlying processes.
title: Agent-based simulation methodology for decomposing teacher quality gap sources

title: Agent-characteristic moderator taxonomy: appearance, gender, nonverbal communication, motion, and voice

description: The article advances a social-genetic research strategy that estimates total interactions between polygenic indices and environmental levels (schools, neighbourhoods, districts, municipalities) using multilevel random-slope models, \"thus remaining agnostic to specific features of environments\".
title: Agnostic multilevel gene-environment interaction framework for testing latent environmental moderation
